title: The Final Parish
author: Cyrus Coldharbour
blurb: Lena Iversen, a true-crime podcaster chasing the coldest case on record, has quietly solved three deaths the police called accidents. Then a confession letter arrives postmarked the day after the funeral — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must trap a killer who knows the case file better than the investigators do before the tide gives up what it took.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
